messages:
Ana R.: Quick follow-up from the onboarding RFC — thinking we should make the 'first-touch' pipeline a strict, super-fast smokehouse that gates admission, and push the heavy bench (full perf/quality) to a non-blocking downstream stage. Thoughts?
Liam: +1 on splitting. main worry: too-loose smoke = more noisy rollbacks later. need concrete SLOs for smoke.
Sophia: Agreed. In practice smoke should only check: model shape/ABI, KV cache sanity, basic tokenization parity, and a tiny golden prompt set. Nothing that needs long token streams.
Mike: Can we define thresholds? e.g. smoke duration < 30s walltime, GPU < 0.1h equivalent, and golden token match ratio > 95% (or flagged).
bench-bot: automated check: ran smoke on model "gpt-small-open" — abi: ok, kv-check: pass, golden-match: 98%, latency-sample p95=180ms. artifacts: s3://bench/smoke/6432109999/report.json
Ana R.: Nice — that output shape is what I had in mind. If any of those checks fail, model is blocked. If smoke passes, we enqueue heavier bench (sampling, long tails, eval sets) which can take hours and does not block admission.
Liam: How do we avoid admitting models that pass smoke but catastrophically fail in the heavy bench? Need a fast rollback signal. Suggest tagging the rollout as ephemeral for first N hours and routing a small % of traffic to a canary variant.
Sophia: Additions: smoke should also verify quantized artifact exists (if we plan to serve quantized) and a compatibility fingerprint so runtime can detect ABI drift quickly.
Mike: Also add an explicit cost-estimate in smoke metadata (tokens/sec expected, GPU type). That lets infra decide whether to place on Dedicated vs Hosted.
Ana R.: OK actionables: 1) Draft a small RFC PR with the exact smoke checks + numeric thresholds (I'll start). 2) Add a bench-bot change to emit a compact smoke-metadata JSON including cost estimate and artifact URIs (Sophia/mike to pair). 3) Add a canary routing policy to the rollout playbook (Liam).
Liam: I'll prototype the canary flag in the gateway and wire a 1% traffic rule that auto-expands if no regressions after 6h.
Sophia: Pairing window for bench-bot tomorrow 10:30 PT.
Ana R.: Thanks everyone. If we agree on thresholds here I'll open the PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
Mike: :+1: — small nit: call the smoke stage "first-touch" in the docs so it's unambiguous.
Ana R.: Good call — will use "first-touch smokehouse" in the PR.
